set.body:
Rebuild image4s-locus around canonical stable grid-domain identity and zero-copy spatial field views.

Design requirements
- Bind a domain key deterministically or explicitly to persistent grid key, logical index layout/version, and voxel count.
- The same persistent grid/layout cannot acquire unrelated domain identities through convenience construction.
- Restore/attach preserve distinct live owner checks.
- Expose zero-copy spatial field views for spatial images and selected volumes.
- For series, expose a voxel-indexed field whose value is the non-spatial series view.
- Regions represent masks/support; Selection represents ordered packed support; NaN and implicit Boolean images are not foundational missing-support conventions.
- Exact image views connect to locus injections/bijections without another voxel-order convention.

Acceptance criteria
- The bridge owns no image storage and no second grid/domain representation.
- Grid ordinal linearization remains explicit, versioned, last-axis-fastest logical row-major.
- Concurrent attach/restore is deterministic.
- The current source pin compiles; no dirty sibling source composite is accepted as final evidence.

Tests
- Ordinal/index mutual inverse properties for random D2/D3 shapes.
- Deterministic domain-key golden fixtures and collision/conflict cases.
- Same grid/layout restore convergence and different grid/layout divergence.
- Exact view commutes with locus injection/bijection.
- Region transport through bijective views preserves cardinality.
- Packed extraction follows Selection order exactly.
- Spatial and series field views share immutable Ravel storage.
- Widened/different live domain owners fail closed.
- JVM/Scala.js parity and concurrency stress.
set.title: Make the locus bridge canonical, stable, and zero-copy
